data.description:
## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: A duplicates-band dry-run manifest lists every duplicate set written to bridge_state/bootstrap/duplicates-<pass>.manifest.json

Create plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/duplicates_band.py with plan subcommand. Accepts --pass <N>. Imports enumerate_duplicate_anomalies() from ticket-bridge-fsck.py. Writes dry-run manifest to bridge_state/bootstrap/duplicates-<pass>.manifest.json with keeper Jira key+created_at, closee keys+created_at, and additive payload (label set, watcher set, comment-id list). NO Jira-mutating calls. Creates bridge_state/bootstrap/ if missing. Follow orphan_band.py pattern (story 699e). Use argparse subparser so gate/apply can be added incrementally.

## TDD Test Spec
Given enumerate_duplicate_anomalies() returns two duplicate sets; When plan --pass 1 is invoked; Then bridge_state/bootstrap/duplicates-1.manifest.json exists, contains both sets with keeper/closee Jira keys; AND no Jira-mutating AcliClient method was called.

## testing_mode: RED
data.title: Create duplicates_band.py with plan subcommand that writes dry-run manifest
